---
title: "REST API"
---

Generated from the committed OpenAPI contract. [OpenAPI JSON](/api/openapi.json). Prefix routes with `/api` through the BFF; direct API routes have no prefix.

Cookie sessions, CSRF, idempotency and tenant scope follow each operation security definition. Security schemes and request/response fields below form the contract.

## Security schemes

```json
{
  "internalJwt": {
    "type": "http",
    "scheme": "bearer",
    "bearerFormat": "JWT",
    "description": "Short-lived, audience-bound internal token minted by the BFF or the client-credentials grant (ADR-0004, ADR-0012)."
  },
  "sessionCookie": {
    "type": "apiKey",
    "in": "cookie",
    "name": "__Host-verbis_session",
    "description": "Opaque BFF session cookie (httpOnly). State-changing requests also need X-CSRF-Token and an allowed Origin."
  },
  "scimBearer": {
    "type": "http",
    "scheme": "bearer",
    "description": "Per-IdP SCIM token (vscim_…) issued in the admin API."
  },
  "oauthClient": {
    "type": "http",
    "scheme": "basic",
    "description": "Service client credentials (client_secret_basic/post) or a TLS client certificate (RFC 8705)."
  }
}
```

## POST /auth/break-glass/login

Break-glass sign-in (password + TOTP), accepted only from admin-web; every attempt is a critical audit event

```json
{
  "operationId": "BreakGlass.login",
  "security": [],
  "parameters": [],
  "requestBody": {
    "required": true,
    "content": {
      "application/json": {
        "schema": {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/BreakGlassLogin"
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "responses": {
    "200": {
      "description": "Signed in; the session cookie is set",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/BreakGlassLoginResponse"
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "default": {
      "description": "Error (RFC 7807)",
      "content": {
        "application/problem+json": {
          "schema": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## GET /auth/login

Start SSO: redirects to the identity provider (Authorization Code + PKCE or SAML AuthnRequest)

```json
{
  "operationId": "Auth.login",
  "security": [],
  "parameters": [
    {
      "name": "tenant",
      "in": "query",
      "required": false,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "idp",
      "in": "query",
      "required": false,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string",
        "format": "uuid",
        "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "app",
      "in": "query",
      "required": true,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^[a-z]{1,32}$"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "returnTo",
      "in": "query",
      "required": false,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string",
        "maxLength": 512
      }
    }
  ],
  "responses": {
    "302": {
      "description": "Redirect to the IdP"
    },
    "default": {
      "description": "Browser protocol endpoint: failures redirect back to the app with ?authError=<code>, or RFC 7807",
      "content": {
        "application/problem+json": {
          "schema": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## POST /scim/v2/{tenant}/Bulk

```json
    {
      "scimBearer": []
    }
  ],
  "parameters": [],

    "required": true,
```

## GET /scim/v2/{tenant}/Groups

## POST /scim/v2/{tenant}/Groups

Create a group

Requires: manage:Group

```json
{
  "operationId": "Scim.createGroup",
  "security": [
    {
      "scimBearer": []
    }
  ],
  "parameters": [],
  "requestBody": {
    "required": true,
    "content": {
      "application/scim+json": {
        "schema": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "schemas": {
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "displayName": {
              "type": "string",
              "minLength": 1,
              "maxLength": 256
            },
            "externalId": {
              "anyOf": [
                {
                  "type": "string",
                  "maxLength": 512
                },
                {
                  "type": "null"
                }
              ]
            },
            "members": {
              "maxItems": 10000,
              "type": "array",
              "items": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "value": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "maxLength": 64
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "value"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": {}
              }
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "displayName"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": {}
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "responses": {
    "201": {
      "description": "Group",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ScimResource"
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "default": {
      "description": "Error (RFC 7644 §3.12)",
      "content": {
        "application/scim+json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "required": [
              "schemas",
              "status"
            ],
            "properties": {
              "schemas": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                }
              },
              "status": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "scimType": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "detail": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## GET /v1/analytics/odata/Scripts

Bounded OData-shaped BI feed ($top/$skip/$count/$select); tenant ABAC applied

Requires: export:Report

```json
{
  "operationId": "AnalyticsOData.scripts",
  "security": [
    {
      "internalJwt": []
    },
    {
      "sessionCookie": []
    }
  ],
  "parameters": [
    {
      "name": "from",
      "in": "query",
      "required": true,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string",
        "format": "date",
        "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))$"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "to",
      "in": "query",
      "required": true,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string",
        "format": "date",
        "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))$"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "campaignId",
      "in": "query",
      "required": false,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string",
        "format": "uuid",
        "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "teamId",
      "in": "query",
      "required": false,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string",
        "format": "uuid",
        "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "$top",
      "in": "query",
      "required": false,
      "schema": {
        "default": 100,
        "type": "integer",
        "minimum": 1,
        "maximum": 1000
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "$skip",
      "in": "query",
      "required": false,
      "schema": {
        "default": 0,
        "type": "integer",
        "minimum": 0,
        "maximum": 50000
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "$count",
      "in": "query",
      "required": false,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "true",
          "false"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "$select",
      "in": "query",
      "required": false,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string",
        "pattern": "^(key|sessions|completed|completionRate|meanDurationMs)(,(key|sessions|completed|completionRate|meanDurationMs))*$"
```

```json
      }
    }
  },
  "responses": {
    "201": {
      "description": "Created",
      "headers": {
        "location": {
          "description": "URL of the campaign",
          "schema": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "etag": {
          "description": "Current version",
          "schema": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      },
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
```

## GET /v1/connectors/{id}/attached-data-map

Get the attached data → variable mapping

Requires: read:Connector

```json
{
  "operationId": "AttachedDataMap.get",
  "security": [
    {
      "internalJwt": []
    },
    {
      "sessionCookie": []
    }
  ],
  "parameters": [
    {
      "name": "id",
      "in": "path",
      "required": true,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string",
        "format": "uuid",
        "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$",
        "description": "UUIDv7 identifier"
      }
    }
  ],
  "responses": {
    "200": {
      "description": "Mapping",
      "headers": {
        "etag": {
          "description": "Connector version",
          "schema": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      },
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "connectorId": {
                "type": "string",
                "format": "uuid",
                "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$",
                "description": "UUIDv7 identifier"
              },
              "version": {
                "type": "integer",
                "minimum": -9007199254740991,
                "maximum": 9007199254740991
              },
              "attachedData": {
                "maxItems": 300,
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "key": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_.:\\- ]{1,128}$"
                    },
                    "variable": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}$"
                    },
                    "type": {
                      "default": "string",
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "string",
                        "number",
                        "boolean"
                      ]
                    },
                    "writeBack": {
                      "default": false,
                      "type": "boolean"
                    },
                    "pii": {
                      "default": false,
                      "type": "boolean"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "key",
                    "variable",
                    "type",
                    "writeBack",
                    "pii"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                }
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "connectorId",
              "version",
              "attachedData"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "default": {
      "description": "Error (RFC 7807)",
      "content": {
        "application/problem+json": {
          "schema": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```json
      "in": "path",
      "required": true,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string",
        "format": "uuid",
        "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$",
        "description": "UUIDv7 identifier"
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "If-Match",
      "in": "header",
      "required": true,
      "description": "Current ETag (optimistic locking).",
      "schema": {
        "type": "string"
      }
    }
  ],
  "requestBody": {
    "required": true,
    "content": {
      "application/json": {
        "schema": {
          "$ref": "#/components/schemas/EngageAttachedDataMap"
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "responses": {
    "200": {
      "description": "Mapping",
      "headers": {
        "etag": {
          "description": "New connector version",
          "schema": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      },
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "connectorId": {
                "type": "string",
                "format": "uuid",
                "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$",
                "description": "UUIDv7 identifier"
              },
              "version": {
                "type": "integer",
                "minimum": -9007199254740991,
                "maximum": 9007199254740991
              },
              "attachedData": {
                "maxItems": 300,
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "key": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_.:\\- ]{1,128}$"
                    },
                    "variable": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64}$"
                    },
                    "type": {
                      "default": "string",
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "string",
                        "number",
                        "boolean"
                      ]
                    },
                    "writeBack": {
                      "default": false,
                      "type": "boolean"
                    },
                    "pii": {
                      "default": false,
                      "type": "boolean"
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "key",
                    "variable",
                    "type",
                    "writeBack",
                    "pii"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                }
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "connectorId",
              "version",
              "attachedData"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "default": {
      "description": "Error (RFC 7807)",
      "content": {
        "application/problem+json": {
          "schema": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## GET /v1/data-sources

List data source definitions

Requires: read:DataSource

```json
{
  "operationId": "Integrations.listDataSources",
  "security": [
    {
      "internalJwt": []
    },
    {
      "sessionCookie": []
    }
  ],
  "parameters": [
    {
      "name": "limit",
      "in": "query",
      "required": false,
      "schema": {
        "default": 25,
        "type": "integer",
        "minimum": 1,
        "maximum": 100
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "cursor",
      "in": "query",
      "required": false,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string",
        "maxLength": 2048
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "sort",
      "in": "query",
      "required": false,
      "schema": {
        "default": "-createdAt",
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "createdAt",
          "-createdAt",
          "key",
          "-key"
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      "name": "protocol",
      "in": "query",
      "required": false,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string",
        "enum": [
          "rest",
          "soap",
          "graphql"
        ]
      }
    }
  ],
  "responses": {
    "200": {
      "description": "A page of data sources",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/DataSourcePage"
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "default": {
      "description": "Error (RFC 7807)",
      "content": {
        "application/problem+json": {
          "schema": {
            "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ProblemDetails"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## POST /v1/scripts/{id}/versions

Create a draft version

The document is validated with @verbis/script-schema; errors return 422 with `errors[].code`.

Requires: create:ScriptVersion

```json
{
  "operationId": "Scripts.createVersion",
  "security": [
    {
      "internalJwt": []
    },
    {
      "sessionCookie": []
    }
  ],
  "parameters": [
    {
      "name": "id",
      "in": "path",
      "required": true,

      }
    },

          }
        }
      }
    },

      "content": {
```

```json
                    "code": {

                    }
                  },
                  "required": [

                    "passed",
                    "durationMs",
                    "assertions"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                }
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "checksum",
              "version",
              "passed",
              "checkedAt",
              "results"

            "additionalProperties": false
```

## POST /v1/sessions/{id}/attach

Acquire or renew the first-tab writer lease; another tab receives read-only state

Requires: update:Session

```json
{
  "operationId": "RuntimeCommands.attach",
  "security": [
    {
      "internalJwt": []
    },
    {
      "sessionCookie": []
    }
  ],
  "parameters": [
    {
      "name": "id",
      "in": "path",
      "required": true,
      "schema": {
        "type": "string",
        "format": "uuid",
        "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$",
        "description": "UUIDv7 identifier"
      }
    }
  ],
  "requestBody": {
    "required": true,
    "content": {
      "application/json": {
        "schema": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "tabId": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "uuid",
              "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
            },
            "writeToken": {
              "type": "string",
              "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "tabId"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "responses": {
    "201": {
      "description": "Writer lease",
      "content": {
        "application/json": {
          "schema": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "id": {
                "type": "string",
                "format": "uuid",
                "pattern": "^([0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000|ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff)$"
              },
              "state": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "launching",
                  "active",
                  "paused",
                  "wrapup",
                  "completed",
                  "abandoned",
                  "expired"
                ]
              },
              "sequence": {
                "type": "integer",
                "minimum": -9007199254740991,
                "maximum": 9007199254740991
              },
              "readOnly": {
                "type": "boolean"
              },
              "snapshot": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "variables": {
                    "default": {},
                    "type": "object",
                    "propertyNames": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "additionalProperties": {
                      "$ref": "#/components/schemas/JsonValue"
                    }
                  },
                  "currentPage": {
                    "default": null,
                    "type": [
                      "string",
                      "null"
                    ]
                  },
                  "history": {
                    "default": [],
                    "maxItems": 100,
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    }
                  },
                  "timers": {
                    "default": {},
                    "type": "object",
                    "propertyNames": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "additionalProperties": {
                      "type": "integer",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 9007199254740991
                    }
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "variables",
                  "currentPage",
                  "history",
                  "timers"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false
              },
              "writeToken": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "leaseUntil": {
                "anyOf": [
                  {
                    "type": "string",
                    "format": "date-time",
                    "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d:[0-5]\\d(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:Z))$"
                  },
                  {
                    "type": "null"
                  }
```
